title: Helm chart Service port: Service-facing consumers use mlflow.servicePort, container-facing ones keep server.value_options.port
answers: The Service should expose port 80 but the MLflow container listens on 5000; how do I set that in the Helm chart?
Why does the CronJob's MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI or the NOTES.txt URL show a different port than the container?
Where does the chart decide which port the Kubernetes Service listens on?
When I set service.port, what else in the chart changes, and what stays on the container port?
body:
Path: charts/templates/service.yaml renders the Service `ports`; charts/templates/cronjob.yaml builds the in-cluster MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI used by garbage-collection jobs; charts/templates/NOTES.txt prints the LoadBalancer URL and the port-forward hint. All three resolve the Service port through charts/templates/_helpers.tpl:mlflow.servicePort, which returns `.Values.service.port` or falls back to `server.value_options.port`.
Rule: Anything that addresses the Kubernetes Service (external URL, in-cluster tracking URI, the remote side of port-forward) takes its port from `mlflow.servicePort`. Anything about the container (deployment containerPort, probes, the server's own --port argument, the local side of port-forward) keeps reading `server.value_options.port`. Keep the values.yaml default as `service.port: ""` so the fallback remains the default.
Symptom: Before this change the Service port was hard-wired to `server.value_options.port`, so a Service could not expose the conventional port 80 while the container listened on 5000. Had the port been decoupled without updating the CronJob and NOTES, the tracking URI and the printed URL would have pointed at the container port rather than the Service port.
Constraints: An unset `service.port` gives exactly the old behaviour, so existing installs render the same. The helper uses sprig `default`, so any falsy override (including 0) falls back to the server port. The helper returns a string, so format it with `%s` in printf. Does not change the container's listening port or probe ports.
applies: MLflow Helm chart Service, CronJob tracking URI, and NOTES.txt; applies when changing how the Service or its port is exposed in charts/.
says: The MLflow Service should expose port 80 while the container listens on 5000
Helm chart Service port setting does not change the container port
CronJob tracking URI in the MLflow chart shows a different port than the container
NOTES.txt URL printed after install shows the wrong port for the MLflow Service
Setting a custom service port in the MLflow Helm chart should leave the container port unchanged
search: MLflow Helm chart Service port: an optional service.port override decouples the Service port from the server port. Service-facing consumers (Service ports, CronJob tracking URI, NOTES.txt URL) use the service port helper, while container-facing settings (containerPort, probes, server argument) keep the server port. An unset override keeps the old behaviour.
